title: Overcast Compat Generated Group Promotions
description: compat/model/promotions.json — the candidate → gated soak ledger of docs/plans/compat-coverage-modelgen.md § 3.6. It is an *input* to cmd/compatgen, which emits each generated group's `state` from it; the generator owns compat/suites/registry.generated.json and this file is the only way to move a group's state. `go run ./cmd/compat --promote-generated` is the sole writer: it records a candidate's first observation and flips it to gated once N consecutive nightly runs agreed with zero failures. Two tools writing the generated registry is precisely what this file exists to avoid.

groups.description: Generated group name → its soak record. Keys are sorted, so a promotion is a one-line diff wherever it lands in the file.

state.description: The state cmd/compatgen emits for this group. A group with no entry here is a candidate, so the file records only groups that have been observed at least once.

firstSeen.description: The date the soak first saw the group (YYYY-MM-DD), written once and never rewritten. It is what makes a candidate age: one that has not promoted 30 days after this date is reported overdue, which is the only thing stopping a group that can never agree from reporting forever and gating nothing.

promotedAt.description: The date the group promoted to gated (YYYY-MM-DD).

runs.description: The identifiers of the runs whose agreement justified the promotion — the base names of the run reports --promote-generated read. Recorded so a promotion can be audited back to the artifacts it rests on rather than taken on trust.
